thread:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: Pager triggered — experimental prompt route (prompt-v3) experiencing sustained 5xx spike in us-east1 canary. Condition: error_rate > 10% (3m). Paging oncall.
Alice (ops): Bob, you got the page? ACME reported failed requests.
Bob (oncall): On it. Looking at dashboards — spike aligns with canary traffic to /v3/prompt -> 502/503 + KV cache OOM logs on gpu-pool-2.
Bob (oncall): Proposing immediate ff kill for the experimental mux: `ff.promptv3_mux`. Will coordinate before flip.
Claire (eng): Agree — kill the flag for safety. Command is: `./ffctl toggle ff.promptv3_mux --off --reason \"canary 5xx spike\"` — confirm you have control plane access.
Bob (oncall): Executing toggle now, notifying infra and support.
Incident Bot: Audit log: feature-flag `ff.promptv3_mux` toggled OFF by Bob (oncall) at 1834567020. Previous state: ON. Reason: canary 5xx spike.
David (support): Notifying affected customer (ACME): "We've rolled back an experimental prompt route; your traffic is routed to the stable model. We're investigating; no data loss expected."
Emily (sre): Capturing traces and kv cache dumps. Point of interest: quantized kernel mismatch errors around `kern_select.cpp:214`. Pushing trace: http://internal/trace/1834567001
Bob (oncall): Telemetry: 30s after toggle error-rate trending to baseline, 0.8% error now, latency back to normal. Re-routing success confirmed.
Claire (eng): Handing to eng for RCA. Opening ticket and postmortem. ETA initial RCA: 2 hours. Need rollout job id and canary logs.
Alice (ops): Rollout id: `deploy-2026-03-17-09-promptv3`. Canary logs exported to gs://redwood-incidents/1834567001/
David (support): CS updated ACME and queued a follow-up call if they want details.
Bob (oncall): Marking paging incident resolved. If we see new spikes, I'll re-open. :white_check_mark:
Emily (sre): Leaving notes in the incident ticket: possible kernel selection regression with quantized path; will reproduce locally and attach reproduction steps.
Claire (eng): Thanks all — will publish postmortem and mitigation plan once RCA complete.
summary: On-call paged for prompt-v3 canary 5xx spike; oncall toggled feature flag ff.promptv3_mux off to rollback new prompt route; error rates returned to baseline; handoff to engineering for RCA and postmortem.
